texts.setting.randomseed.about: The number the core's random numbers start from. A game that calls randomize() takes its seed from this sequence and not from your computer, so the same seed and the same inputs give the same game. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.starttime.about: The date and time the game reads when it starts, in UTC. GameMaker's date and time functions answer from it, and it then runs on with the game, never with your computer. The default is the first of January 2010. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: A game made with GameMaker 8.0 or 8.1: the .exe its maker published. Games made with GameMaker Studio or later do not run here.
texts.slot.savedata.help: What the game already saved, as Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote it: a .zip of the files the game wrote. They are put where the game finds its files before it starts.
